The x-axis is labeled 'Month' and displays the months: Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar, May.
The bar for May is the shortest, visually indicating the lowest release volume among all months shown.
The bar for Jan is the tallest, reaching 40,000 m³.
The bar for Apr is at 30,000 m³.
The bar for Mar is at 27,000 m³.
The bar for Feb is at 20,000 m³.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the monthly reservoir release dashboard and decide whether May should be handled as a standard low-release case or escalated as a critical low-release anomaly for this reporting cycle.
The chart reference is to use the monthly reservoir release dashboard as the evidence source for deciding the appropriate May low-release severity route.

The primary field label is 'May low-release route' with three options: 'Route May to standard low-release follow-up', 'Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review', 'Send May to background monthly record filing'.
